entries.title: Isaiah 34:1
segments: God is about to execute judgments upon the enemies of his people. Among these Edom is specified by name, because of its peculiar enmity to Judah.
Its doom, like that of Moab,
, and that of Philistia, Edom, Moab, and Ammon,

, stands as a type of the destruction which awaits all the foes of Zion. 
 
The utter and perpetual desolation of the nations that anciently opposed themselves to God's covenant people, is at once a standing memorial of the truth of prophecy, and a terrible type of the destruction that awaits all the enemies of his church.  If such be the power of God's anger in this world, who can endure that "furnace of fire" which "shall not be quenched night nor day," and whose smoke "shall go up for ever?"

entries.title: Isaiah 34:2
segments: He hath utterly destroyed them; the prophet speaks of the future desolation as already past, because God had decreed it.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:4
segments: The host of heaven shall be dissolved; see note on

entries.title: Isaiah 34:5
segments:
Bathed; with the blood of Edom. 
 
  In heaven; because God who wields it is in heaven.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:6
segments: Lambs--goats--rams; like "unicorns" and "bullocks" in the next verse, representing the Idumeans under the figure of animals slaughtered for a sacrifice.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:7
segments:
Unicorns; probabaly wild buffaloes; that is, the most fierce and mighty among the people. 
 
  Come down; to the slaughter.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:9
segments:
vv 9-10. 
 
  Thereof; of Edom. 
 
  Shall be turned into pitch--shall go up for ever; a figurative description of complete desolation, drawn from the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:11
segments:
vv 11-15. 
 
  The cormorant--the vultures; compare notes on

. 
 
  He shall stretch out--the stones of emptiness; he shall measure it with line and plummet for utter desolation. 
 
  To the kingdom; that is, to defend and maintain it.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:16
segments:
Seek ye out of the book of the Lord; God challenges his people to compare the prophecy with its fulfilment. 
 
  No one of these; these inhabitants of desolated places.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:17
segments: Cast the lot for them--divided it--by line; hath allotted it to them for their habitation.
